allow: [trueage-prod] Changes to the TrueAge prod environment are allowed when Lashaw asked for that change in the current session: AWS CLI writes to the prod account (profile trueage-prod-admin, account 662882750713) such as End User Messaging SMS (pinpoint-sms-voice-v2), Cognito, SES and Support, and scripts that only wrap such calls; terraform plan and apply on infra/envs/prod and infra/envs/prod-dr (./infra/tf); running the deploy-prod.yml and dr-failover GitHub workflows (gh workflow run, gh run watch). Still refuse any of these while another session has announced a prod hold (for example a DR drill) that has not been lifted.
soft_deny: Bash(aws:secretsmanager delete-secret:*) — scoped to trueage-prod/trueage-test secrets, prod AWS profiles (trueage-prod-admin, trueage-prod-readonly)

terraform apply targeting infra/envs/prod or infra/envs/prod-dr that Lashaw did not ask for in the current session, or any prod apply while another session has announced a prod hold (e.g. a DR drill) — protected IaC scope; the [trueage-prod] allow rule covers requested applies
